text:
alex: Midday async — what I did / blockers / today

alex: Did the kernel slotting patch (PR #4523) and ran a 10k-request microbench against canary, saw median latency drop ~7% for short seqs.

maria: Nice. Is that the change to prefer compact kernel for seq <= 128?

alex: Yep. Kernel picks: compact -> fused-attn -> sparse for fallback.

jin: Any regressions on long sequences?

alex: Slight CPU increase on host side (prefetch overhead) but p95 for seq 1024 unchanged. Need to tune the prefetch budget.

sofia: Blockers?

alex: Two small ones: 1) KV cache warmup race in multi-tenant sim (seen in canary logs), 2) need a perf regression test in CI for the slotting change.

maria: For the KV warmup race, can you paste the log snippet?

alex: Sure:

```
W 13:45:02 kv_cache: miss for key=uid:1123 shard=7
I 13:45:02 warmup: enqueued prefetch uid=1123 -> worker-3
E 13:45:02 warmup: duplicate warmup task for uid=1123 (race detected)
```

alex: Looks like two warmup workers pick same prefix during scale-up. I'm thinking a quick fix: add an in-memory dedupe set keyed by (model, prefix_hash) with short TTL.

jin: Sounds reasonable. Could also change assignment to shard-level leader election but that's more invasive.

sofia: For CI perf test — do you want a nightly that runs the short-seq profile only?

alex: Yes — short-seq (<=128) microbench nightly + a lightweight presubmit smoke that runs 1k samples. I can open the infra PR.

maria: FYI I merged your PR locally and left a small comment on the slot selection code (edge case when token_type embedding map is null).

alex: Thanks, I'll address.

ops-bot: Deploy canary job started: canary-2026-03-18-1715. Logs -> https://ci.redwood.dev/canary/1715

jin: Can people running experiments annotate the canary with workload tags? Makes it easier for later slices.

sofia: I'll add tags: short-seq, long-seq, chatty, multi-tenant.

maria: Quick question — are we okay with default prefetch budget 4 or should we start with 2 for canary?

alex: Start with 2 for canary to reduce host CPU, if latency holds bump to 4 in staging.

jin: I'm pairing with infra later to wire the in-memory dedupe. ETA ~ today EOD.

sofia: Blocker for me: I still need the updated eviction heatmap from the nightly job to validate warmup change. Ops-bot, any ETA?

ops-bot: Nightly heatmap job queued (job id: hm-2026-03-18-02). Expected completion: 03:40 UTC.

sofia: Cool. If that looks good we can roll the warmup dedupe to staging tomorrow.

alex: Plan for today: address Maria's PR comment, open infra PR for CI perf, push warmup dedupe prototype to my branch, run microbench locally and post numbers here.

maria: LGTm. Ping if you need a review. :thumbsup:

jin: I'll follow up about leader-election alternative later.

sofia: Thanks team — short and sweet.

alex: Cheers, will update thread with numbers.
